messages:
maria: Uploaded perfetto trace for the 2:15pm regression. Link: https://perfetto.internal/r/abc123 :mag_right:

maria: Quick notes — saw a kernel-score flip at ~2300ms. KV cache miss spike lines up with a batch boundary at 32 tokens. Client->gateway->runtime spans are all present in the trace.

alex: Thanks. TL;DR? What's the likely root cause?

samir: First-pass: kernel selection hysteresis + batched KV eviction. When batch size crosses 32 we seem to take a kernel-variant path (INT8 shim) which triggers a host-device copy + sync. Perfetto shows a GPU stall + memcpy right at the switch.

maria: Attaching the nsys fragment I exported (keeps it tiny):

```
# nsys snippet (trimmed)
# Time(ms)    Event
2296.40       kernel_select_variant id=0x4e score_delta=+0.8
2296.50       memcpy H2D 4.1MB (synchronous)
2297.00       kernel_launch variant_int8 grid=(256,1,1)
2297.40       GPU stall (waiting for memcpy)
```

alex: Can you paste the perfetto slices for client/gateway/runtime boundaries? Also which model + seq_len?

maria: Model: redwood/gpt-slim-6B, seq_len=512, batch_policy=auto (adaptive_threshold=32). Workload: short QPS spike from gateway test harness.

samir: Another data point: KV cache counters show a ~50% increase in lookup latency when batch>32 (cold lookups + more prefetch churn). My hypothesis: prefetch heuristic fires extra async fetches that evict hot lines under this batch/sequence pattern.

perfetto-bot: perfetto: slice "kernel_select" at 00:02.296 -> https://perfetto.internal/slices/xyz (markers: select, memcpy, launch)

maria: Action items I propose:
1) Reproduce locally with seq=512, batch=34 (just over threshold).
2) Run nsys capture: `nsys profile --trace=nvtx,cuda --output=repro-2176543210 ./bin/repro_run --seq 512 --batch 34` and upload .qdrep to perfetto.
3) Try fixed batching policy of 24 to see if perf goes back to baseline (to confirm threshold trigger).

alex: I'll take (1) and (2) — pinging @infra for a spare GPU for a quick repro :point_up:

infra: GPU reserved on prod-test-02 for 45m under tag `repro-2176543210`. Use user:infra for access.

samir: If you reproduce, next quick experiment: force-disable kernel-variant fallback in runtime (environment `REDWOOD_DISABLE_VARIANT=1`) and measure end-to-end p95. If p95 drops, selection logic is suspect. If not, dig deeper into KV prefetch eviction.

maria: Sounds good. I'll also generate heatmap of KV lookups from perfetto (KV layer emits counters) and attach after repro.

alex: Repro started — uploading nsys qdrep in ~10m. If anyone wants immediate slices I can paste screen gifs.

maria: Thanks — once we have the qdrep I'll correlate memcpy timings with kernel_select events and post a short note. :thumbsup:
